annotationAttribution: Fashionpedia Consortium, Fashionpedia validation 2020 instance segmentation annotations, Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
selectionRule: Fixed eight ascending-ID CC BY2 polygon-only multi-garment val examples chosen for dress/top/shirt/bottom/shoe coverage before model inference; current creator/license independently verified on Flickr primary pages. No prediction-driven selection.
split: official public val2020 reference; NOT sealed novel acceptance
pretrainingContamination: Unknown; public validation may occur in model pretraining. No blind generalization claim.
categoryScope: Official categories 0-26 only; human garment parts 27+ excluded from object-instance scope. Each shoe annotation remains its own instance.

photoLicenseReceipt.assertion: Current primary Flickr JSON-LD and official Fashionpedia image metadata agree on CC BY 2.0; annotation license is separate.
